risks.risk: Brake performance may be weak (worn pads/warped rotor or misalignment), even if brakes look present.
risks.proof: Seller video: bicycle rolling slowly, then hard stop test from a few meters; show both front and rear brake engagement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes not fully reliable (worst case: needs service/adjustment).

risks.risk: Tyres may be worn, cracked, or have low tread despite appearing intact.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tyres (tread pattern) plus a photo of sidewall condition; include a coin-depth check if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres needing replacement soon.

risks.risk: Gear system may skip or not shift properly (derailleur alignment, cable stretch, bent derailleur).
risks.proof: Video: shift through all gears while pedaling; show no skipping and smooth indexing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as gears not working properly (worst case: needs adjustment/parts).

risks.risk: Folding hinge/joints may have play or looseness (safety risk).
risks.proof: Photo/video: push/pull test at the folding joints and frame hinge while holding the bike; show any wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible looseness requiring tightening/repair.

risks.risk: Wheel alignment/rims may be bent or tyres may rub (not visible clearly in one angle).
risks.proof: Video: spin both wheels and show side view for wobble/rubbing; include brake-to-rim clearance view.
risks.if_unproven: Price as wheels may need truing.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the frame for any readable brand/model markings (head tube, down tube, seat tube).
Video test: braking (front + rear) from a short distance to confirm stopping power.
Video test: shift through all gears while pedaling (no skipping).
Close-ups of tyre tread and sidewalls on both wheels.
Video/photo of folding hinge/joints showing no wobble (push/pull test).
response.reason: From photo 0, it’s clearly a folding bicycle, but the exact brand/model and the key functional condition (brakes, tyres, gears, folding hinge safety) can’t be verified remotely. To price safely for Rivers pickups, we need proof of braking, shifting, and tyre condition.
